name: Planet Love Story
summary:
Planet Love Story is a melancholic adventure about love, memory and the boundary between life and death. An amnesiac woman awakens alone in a desert on the moon, a place believed to receive the souls of the dead. Meanwhile, a man on Earth attempts to build a rocket capable of reaching her and bringing her back.

Presented in a picture-book-like visual style, the game follows two people separated by an impossible distance as their stories gradually converge.
